Chooses the font that [Text](Text), [Print](Print), [StringWidth](StringWidth) and the other text commands use from now on.
@param font  A handle from [LoadFont](LoadFont). 0 goes back to the built-in font.
@gap A font that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
